profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with mechanical and electrical engineering experience in the power industry. In my previous experiences, I developed safe and robust solutions that critical systems such as our electrical grid depend on.

I am a highly adaptable, self-motivated individual with a passion for creating software to automate workflows and optimize system performance. I am a team player and  I will bring a positive mindset to any work environment. Please feel free to reach out for any opportunities!

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
Full time 500+ hour, 12-week training program dedicated to developing a well-rounded technical foundation for software engineering. 

Languages Learned: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, SQL
Libraries/Frameworks Learned: Express.js, Django.js, Mongoose, React.js
Misc. Tools Learned: Git/Github, OOP, RESTful APIs, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Heroku

positions.title: NBA Fantasy Draft App
positions.description:
Utilized the MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) stack to develop a NBA Fantasy Draft clone. This application includes multi-user functionality with live updates to all connected clients by using Web Sockets. 

This application fetches NBA player statistics from the previous season using a 3rd party API (balldontlie API). Projected fantasy scores are calculated based on a user defined scoring system. 

Tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Bootstrap, Express.js, Node.js, Sockets.io, APIs, MongoDB, Mongoose, Git, Github, Heroku

positions.title: MacroManager App
positions.description:
Utilized Django and PostgreSQL to develop a full stack task management web application where users can manage and prioritize business tasks for their organizations. The application implements Django’s built in authentication and authorization techniques.

Developed this application in a team setting utilizing Agile methodologies (Scrum) and document version control (Github). I served as the Scrum Master, organizing the standup meetings and managing the kanban board on Trello. 

Tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Git, Github, Heroku

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: In addition to my responsibilities at the Associate level, I developed proposals for new projects, interfaced directly with clients as the main point of contact, and managed projects and client expectations. I helped expand the company's services to include PLC and RTAC programming.
positions.insights: Renewable Energy, 3D Modeling Software and +15 skills

positions.title: Associate Mechanical Engineer
positions.description: I have led and worked in multidisciplinary teams performing mechanical and electrical engineering design and construction for power generation projects such as hydroelectric plants, solar, wind turbine farms, battery energy storage, electrical substations, and electrical distribution networks. Additionally, I performed research and aided in pursuing new contracts for decarbonization technologies such as green hydrogen, carbon capture and sequestration, grid-scale battery storage, and natural gas power plant hybridization.
positions.insights: Renewable Energy, 3D Modeling Software and +13 skills

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked on engineering design for retrofits and upgrades to existing power generation facilities. I performed a variety of tasks including sizing equipment, designing layouts, document management, AutoCAD drafting, and drawing review.

positions.title: Student Lead
positions.description: Managed student workers at the UC Davis Bookstore Warehouse. Coordinated with buyers and resolved problem orders. Responsible for all shipments from the warehouse clothing department to the UC Davis Stores.
positions.insights: Inventory Management, Customer Service and +2 skills

positions.title: Student Warehouse Associate
positions.description: My responsibilities include processing incoming merchandise shipments, distributing merchandise to the respective UC Davis bookstores, and maintaining warehouse organization.
positions.insights: Inventory Management, Customer Service and +1 skill
